claim.scope_statement: For each fixed0<delta<1/8, uniformly for T^(7/8+delta)<=H<=T, integral_T^(T+H)|zeta(1/2+it)|^4 dt is asymptotic to H(log T)^4/(2pi^2). The deduction uses Heath-Brown’s global polynomial formula with O_epsilon(T^(7/8+epsilon)) error. Higher moments and shorter intervals are not settled.
